documented_patches.reason: IR-88-76: added excess_overlap() and binding_duplicate_decision_v3(). The literal 3 px dot-overlap rule returns 1.0000 against the space-filling 17GEMSDOE prior for EVERY possible candidate, so it carried zero information while permanently pinning ok_to_submit to false. The addition is append-only: no existing function, constant or code path was altered, so every previously recorded uniqueness number is reproducible byte-for-byte. The brief requires shared defects to be fixed once in the template rather than forked. IR-88-86 appends a single shared compatibility correction: v3 now binds on literal overlap including dense priors, and fails closed on missing/nonfinite measurements. Earlier chance-corrected outputs remain historical diagnostics, never submission authorization.

IR-88-SDTL-01: a continuous registry surface positive on every allowed cell makes the literal 3 px dot test unsatisfiable for every candidate. v5 compares a candidate's dots with the top-n cells of such a surface at the candidate's own dot count (the emission that surface would itself make), keeps the 0.70/0.90 thresholds, keeps rank correlation against every raster, and still reports the literal reading. Append-only: no existing function, constant or code path altered; v3/v4 remain callable.
